paper.title_en: The shadow of rotating FJNW metric
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the astrophysical aspects of the rotating Fisher-Janis-Newman-Winicour (FJNW) metric recently derived in [1]. The Hamilton-Jacobi equation is used to obtain the shadow of the rotating FJNW metric. We find that increasing the angular momentum parameter a and the metric parameter γleads to an increase in the size of the shadow. Finally, we study the deflection angle of light in the rotating FJNW spacetime.
paper.journal_ref: International Journal of Geometric Methods in Modern Physics (2026) 2750017
